# Monthly Spending Review

Open the file and find the right columns, which vary, then go through it and put things into groups like housing and food and so on although you can add others if needed, and leave out the transfers unless they matter, and also the income, then add up each group and show them in some kind of table or list sorted however makes sense, and mention big purchases and anything new or unusual, and if there is a previous month you could compare but only if it is helpful, and watch out for debits and credits being in separate columns in which case handle that, and if lots of things end up in other then maybe ask, and make sure it all adds up, and keep it private.
